summary_en: 5,040,000 shares (0.57% S/O) up to ¥22,554M via ToSTNeT-3 at closing price of ¥4,475/share on 2026-08-20 morning. Block execution within single trading session window. Cumulative to date: 38,496,700 shares acquired for ¥168,929.7M under parent authorization (¥200B / 54M shares authorized 2026-01-29 through 2027-01-29).
title_en: Notice regarding purchase of treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Canon announces a single-block treasury share purchase via ToSTNeT-3 (off-auction electronic trading) on the morning of 2026-08-20. The block comprises up to 5,040,000 shares at an aggregate ceiling of ¥22,554,000,000, priced at the previous day's closing price of ¥4,475/share. This block is one tranche of the broader authorization approved by the board on 2026-01-29, which permits acquisition of up to 54,000,000 shares (6.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for up to ¥20,000,000,000 over the twelve-month window from 2026-01-30 to 2027-01-29, via both ToSTNeT-3 and negotiated in-venue transactions. As of the date of this notice, cumulative purchases under that program total 38,496,700 shares for ¥168,929,707,500. The order is limited to the specified trading session only, and partial or complete non-execution may occur depending on market conditions.
